name: io.github.cyberchronos00/cg-code-graph
title: code-graph
description: Local dependency graph: callers, entry points and file:line evidence for what a change affects.

packageArguments.name: --db
packageArguments.description: Graph database built by `cg index . --db out/graph.db`; relative paths resolve from the working directory.

packageArguments.name: --tools
packageArguments.description: Tool allowlist: `core` lists a small set of tools; `all` or unset lists every tool (also CG_MCP_TOOLS).
